arrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d68","from":100,"to":100,"text":"苏天晴露出诡计得逞的坏笑，借月光观赏魔法少女风信子被复活的黑狼怪人抓住的狼狈模样。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind","r_heiwolf"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d69","from":101,"to":102,"text":"这是强化药A赋予黑狼怪人的终极能力，能在倒下后发动；第二阶段展开。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_drugA","r_heiwolf"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d71","from":105,"to":106,"text":"苏天晴悠哉走到边上，黑狼贴心将猎物从半空放下但仍未松开束缚风信子的利爪；娇俏金狐在南小风眼里俨然是小恶魔。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_heiwolf","r_wind"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d74","from":109,"to":110,"text":"南小风几乎是嘶吼着；只有加大音量才能压制被利爪抓住的恐惧，她不愿在比自己小的陌生魔法少女面前露怯。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_sutianqing"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d78","from":116,"to":117,"text":"狐狐停下脚步饶有兴趣地回头；天蓝的魔法少女猛然怔住，脸颊泛红。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d80","from":119,"to":119,"text":"碧色狐眸映在风信子眼中，模样娇俏可爱，却分明藏着一股玩味笑意。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d84","from":125,"to":126,"text":"苏天晴踱步走到风信子身后，月光映出她脸上坏笑，然后捏起一根狗尾巴草。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_sutianqing","r_wind"]}},{"collection":"disclosures","record":{"id":"d86","from":129,"to":129,"text":"蓉城绿心公园里回荡着少女的哀鸣。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_wind","r_park","r_rongcheng"]}}]}
